title: notification preference: quiet_hours declares the quiet-hours widget hint (server half of #31421)
body:
domain:ui#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jVEjiYrK7onirxUGyo

Filing gate: **④ coordination child**, the server half of #31421 (carries its widget hint; #31421 keeps the ui control). #31421's filer named it: "If the ui needs the field to declare a widget hint, as the topic and channel fields do since #31004, that is a small server half. Name it here and the server lane cuts it."
Business reason: an administrator sets 免打扰 (quiet hours) on a notification preference with a time-zone picker and two times instead of hand-writing `{ "tz": …, "start": …, "end": … }`. Without this hint the ui control from #31421 is never chosen and Setup keeps the JSON box.
Reader: a `domain:server` seat, a one-line change; the ui half (#31421, `domain:ui#3`) builds in parallel and lands independently.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `quiet_hours widget`, `quiet-hours` → #31421 and #30208 only; none is this hint.

## 维护者速读

「免打扰」字段要换成时间段控件，前端已在 #31421 里做。前端只认字段上的 widget 提示（和同一对象的 topic、channel 字段一样），所以服务端要给 `quiet_hours` 加一行 `widget: 'quiet-hours'`。存储格式不变。

## What to do

- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts`, `quiet_hours: Field.json({ … })` (~L202 on `origin/main` `216b18a6c`): add `widget: 'quiet-hours'`, with the same kind of `[#30208 row 6]` comment the `topic` (~L142–149, `widget: 'notification-topic'`) and `channel` (~L174–178) fields carry.
- Measured by #31421's dev at step 1 (report `/mnt/project-files/issue-31421/step1.md` in the fleet project): the record form resolves form widget → `field.widget` → type, so a `json` field with no hint goes to the JSON editor. `FieldSchema.widget` is a free string, and an unregistered name degrades to the JSON editor, so this can land before or after the ui half.
- Storage shape unchanged: `{ tz?, start: 'HH:MM', end: 'HH:MM' }`.

## Acceptance

- A pin that `quiet_hours` declares `widget: 'quiet-hours'`, beside whatever pins the topic and channel hints today.

Refs #31421, #30208
